This is arguably the most amazing app I have come across recently. It has significantly improved my typing efficiency, giving me a much clearer flow of thought and a stronger desire to communicate exactly what is on my mind.

In the past, I never had the motivation to write this much. Now, I can handle it effortlessly through this tool.

What's even more impressive is that I am actually speaking in Chinese right now, yet it has already automatically translated my speech into English. The translation is both fluent and accurate. I really love this app!
